purpose: Which role owns what during the local migration replay, and which statements must run privileged. The PostgreSQL 17 transition needs this written down: the chain is sensitive to the role model in both directions, and no grant short of SUPERUSER can reproduce the privileged statements.

roles.name: postgres
roles.attributes: NOSUPERUSER (required by the G014 owner contract)

roles.name: privacy_workflow_owner
roles.attributes: NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOINHERIT NOLOGIN NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS
roles.ownerRule: created and normalized by a privileged statement

rules.rule: Role attribute statements (anything mentioning SUPERUSER) run as supabase_admin; PostgreSQL refuses them for a non-superuser even when it created the role and holds CREATEROLE.
rules.verifiedBy: probe 2026-11-11: CREATE ROLE ok, ALTER ROLE refused with 'Only roles with the SUPERUSER attribute may alter roles with the SUPERUSER attribute'

rules.rule: Object DDL runs as postgres. Objects created by a privileged run are owned by supabase_admin and the following postgres migrations cannot use them ('permission denied for schema privacy_retention' after the mixed-role probe).
rules.verifiedBy: mixed-role probe 2026-11-11: 74 applied, new failure class

rules.rule: The privileged pre-pass creates and normalizes roles only; it never creates schemas, tables, functions or grants.
A migration that mixes role statements with object DDL keeps a replacement body until it is split; that is exactly what PG15_REPLAY_ADAPTERS.v1.json lists.

privacy_retention is owned by privacy_workflow_owner. postgres reaches it through explicit schema/table/function grants only: role membership is forbidden, because the g013/g014 guards raise 'privacy_workflow_owner role attributes are incompatible' when the role has any membership.
rules.verifiedBy: mixed probe 2026-11-11 with role-grant-normalisation.v1.sql: 87 applied, and privacy_workflow_owner reports 0 memberships

rules.rule: Migrations that SET ROLE privacy_workflow_owner cannot run as postgres (that would need the forbidden membership) and belong to the privileged set.
rules.verifiedBy: mixed probe 2026-11-11: 'must be member of role "privacy_workflow_owner"' after the grant normalisation

openQuestions: Which migrations require SET ROLE privacy_workflow_owner, and can each be replaced by a SECURITY DEFINER path instead of a privileged run?
The GoTrue bootstrap: 20260711000100 requires auth.sessions and auth.refresh_tokens to exist before it runs; the probe cannot supply them without the gotrue image's staged migrations.
